title: Rippers Unmasked — Classes & Skills
description: The Rippers Unmasked class corpus as native Foundry Item packs the GM drags onto Project FU sheets: type:class Items for every Rippers class, their class skills as UUID-linked type:skill Items, and heroic skills as type:heroic Items with their requirements listed. Original campaign content, layered on Project FU. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-compendium.note: Items validate against Project FU's class/skill/heroic DataModels (packs system:projectfu). No FU content is redistributed; no automation code.
